purpose: Five concept-sized additions for upper-level genetics; illustrations are original conceptual SVGs embedded through native Djot image blocks.
added_slide_titles: Repair Starts with a Matching Copy
One Event Can Make a Patch
LOH Can Supply a Second Hit
Twin Spots Can Test Gene Function
clarifications: Mitotic recombination refers to cycling cells; DNA repair can precede the next mitosis.
Remove the unsupported universal once-per-million upper limit. Rates depend on assay and context.
LOH is an allelic-state change, not necessarily chromosome loss; the illustrated crossover outcome is conditional on segregation.
Cancer and clone-growth examples describe possibilities, not inevitable outcomes.

assets.repair_templates.svg: Matching sister versus homolog; sequence-template arrow is not a crossover.
assets.loh_outcome.svg: Starting G1 diploid cell and two postmitotic diploid daughters; replicated intermediate omitted; two reciprocal recombinants and two intact chromatids represented by the final daughter chromosome colors.
assets.clonal_patches.svg: Conceptual clones within a heterozygous tissue; counts and positions are not data.

sources.supports: Sister-template repair and preference for non-crossover products.
